name: cast_eq_cast_iff
statement:
theorem cast_eq_cast_iff {α β γ : Sort u} {h : α = γ} {h' : β = γ} {a : α} {b : β} :
    cast h a = cast h' b ↔ a = cast (h'.trans h.symm) b

name: cast_symm
statement:
theorem cast_symm {α β : Sort u} {h : α = β} {a : α} {b : β} :
    cast h a = b ↔ a = cast h.symm b

name: dcast_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dcast_eq : dcast (Eq.refl a) b = b

name: dcast_eq_dcast_iff
statement:
theorem dcast_eq_dcast_iff (h : a = a'') (h' : a' = a'') :
    dcast h b = dcast h' b' ↔ b = dcast (h'.trans h.symm) b'

name: dcast_eq_root_cast
statement: theorem dcast_eq_root_cast (h : a = a') : dcast h b = _root_.cast (congrArg β h) b

name: dcast_fun
statement:
theorem dcast_fun {γ : (a : α) → β a → Sort*} {f : (b : β a) → γ a b} :
    f (dcast rfl b) = dcast (α := β a) (β := γ a) dcast_eq.symm (f b)

name: dcast_symm
statement: theorem dcast_symm (ha : a = a') (hb : dcast ha b = b') : dcast (ha.symm) b' = b

name: dcast_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dcast_trans (h : a = a') (h' : a' = a'') :
    dcast h' (dcast h b) = dcast (h.trans h') b

name: heq_of_dcast
statement: theorem heq_of_dcast (ha : a = a') (hb : dcast ha b = b') : HEq b b'

name: AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self (i : ι) (h : i ≤ i) :
    AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT := A) i i h = RingHom.id (A i)

name: AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self_apply
statement:
lemma AlgebraTower.algebraMap_self_apply (i : ι) (h : i ≤ i) (x : A i) :
    AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT := A) i i h x = x

name: AlgebraTowerEquiv.commutesRight'
statement:
lemma AlgebraTowerEquiv.commutesRight' (e : AlgebraTowerEquiv A B)
    {i j : ι} (h : i ≤ j) (r : B i) :
  AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT:=A) (i:=i) (j:=j) (h:=h) ((e.toRingEquiv i).symm r) =
  (e.toRingEquiv j).symm (AlgebraTower.algebraMap (AT:=B) (i:=i) (j:=j) (h:=h) r)

name: Field.mod_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Field.mod_eq_zero {K : Type u} [Field K] (a b : K) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a % b = 0

name: coeffs_of_comp_minus_x
statement:
theorem coeffs_of_comp_minus_x {f : Polynomial F} {n : ℕ} :
    (f.comp (-X)).coeff n = if Even n then f.coeff n else -f.coeff n

name: comp_x_square_coeff
statement:
theorem comp_x_square_coeff {f : Polynomial F} {n : ℕ} :
    (f.comp (X * X)).coeff n = if Even n then f.coeff (n / 2) else 0

name: eq_poly_deg_one
statement:
lemma eq_poly_deg_one {a b c d : F} {x₁ x₂ : F}
    (h1 : a + b * x₁ = c + d * x₁)
    (h2 : a + b * x₂ = c + d * x₂)
    (h1_2 : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.C b * Polynomial.X =
      Polynomial.C c + Polynomial.C d * Polynomial.X

name: inv_two_mul_two
statement:
@[simp]
lemma inv_two_mul_two : 2⁻¹ * (2 : F) = 1

name: two_mul_inv_two
statement:
@[simp]
lemma two_mul_inv_two : (2 : F) * 2⁻¹ = 1

name: Basis.baseChangeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Basis.baseChangeRight_apply (b : Basis ι K Left) (i : ι) :
    (Basis.baseChangeRight (b:=b) (Right:=Right)) i = b i ⊗ₜ[K] 1

name: Basis.baseChangeRight_repr_tmul
statement:
lemma Basis.baseChangeRight_repr_tmul (b : Basis ι K Left) (x y i) :
    (Basis.baseChangeRight (b:=b) (Right:=Right)).repr (x ⊗ₜ y) i = b.repr x i • y

name: comm_map_smul_add
statement:
lemma comm_map_smul_add (s : Right) (x y : Right ⊗[K] Left)
    (hx : e (s • x) = s • (e x)) (hy : e (s • y) = s • (e y)) :
    e (s • x) + e (s • y) = s • e x + s • e y

name: comm_map_smul_tmul
statement:
lemma comm_map_smul_tmul (s s' : Right) (m : Left) :
    e (s • (s' ⊗ₜ[K] m)) = s • (e (s' ⊗ₜ[K] m))
